name: huginn-voice
description: Dictate into the Claude Code prompt box. Speech is transcribed by your own Huginn server (faster-whisper on its GPU), not by a cloud service.

api_key.title: Huginn API key
api_key.description: Your named Huginn key. Leave empty to use HUGINN_API_KEY from the environment.

url.title: Huginn URL
url.description: Leave empty for https://huginn.prawdzik.eu (the server that hosts the ear).

mic.title: Microphone (pulse source)
mic.description: Leave empty for RDPSource (the Windows microphone under WSL2). List sources: ffmpeg -sources pulse

python.title: Python executable
python.description: Leave empty for python3 (runs bin/huginn-ear.py, stdlib only).
